disclosures.title: Jafurah midstream minimum-volume commitment
disclosures.body_text: Aramco retained exclusive use of the Jafurah Field Gas Plant and Riyas NGL Fractionation Plant for 20 years under a quarterly volume-based tariff backed by minimum volume commitments. The report does not disclose the committed volume, so no numeric minimum-volume fact is published.

disclosures.title: Guaranteed offshore and onshore rig purchases
disclosures.body_text: At year-end 2025, Aramco-related entities had remaining guaranteed commitments for 18 offshore rigs valued at SAR 22.275 billion and 36 onshore rigs valued at SAR 6.789 billion. The onshore orders include a maximum cancellation exposure of SAR 945 million.
